snippet.title: Frogmancer - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist FROGMANCER on Steam!
Frogmancer is a hand-drawn survivors-like shooter where you play as a frog wizard defending your lily pad from swarms of flying enemies. Aim, shoot, level up, and shape your build through a variety of overpowered magical attack patterns.

Features:
• Twin-stick shooter gameplay
• Multiple wands and hats with unique passive effects
• Fast, replayable roguelite runs

Add Frogmancer to your wishlist and survive the swarm.
